clips.title: The story
paras: At Lakeshire Inn, travelers and townsfolk seek shelter as danger closes around Lakeshire. On Lake Everstill, the inn offers food, drink, and a place to hear news amid the town’s troubles.

On the shore of Lake Everstill, Lakeshire Inn offers a short rest from the gnoll bands and Blackrock orcs pressing against the town. Though Lakeshire’s military position grows more desperate, the tavern remains warm and welcoming. Barkeep Daniels and Innkeeper Brianna serve ale, wine, and hot meals to locals and travelers. Townspeople gather to trade news, ease their sorrows, and seek hired blades to defend the kingdom’s eastern border.

Wiley the Black watches the room from a table, keeping his thoughts to himself and an eye on dangers in the region. Traveling brewers such as Yorus Barleybrew stop at the inn, and Darcy Parker and other townsfolk visit the common room. For those bound for the jagged peaks or south toward Duskwood, Lakeshire Inn is the last safe haven before the contested wilderness.
